performance.verdict: Organic GBP holding the line; paid channels remain fully dark.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both report $0, 0 leads, 0 clicks. This account is entirely dependent on organic.
GBP spiked 57% week-over-week (49 total actions: 31 directions, 17 web clicks, 1 call), but last 3 days show 0 GBP actions vs 11 on 2026-08-25 — momentum has stopped.
GA4 sessions averaged 4.7/day over last 3 days (2026-08-28 to 2026-08-30) vs 8.0/day in prior 3 days — a confirmed softening in site traffic with no paid lever to compensate.
GA4 records 177 sessions and 147 users over 28 days but 0 conversions — site is receiving visitors but capturing no leads, pointing to a form or tracking gap.

suggestions.text: Monitor GBP actions daily; 3-day streak of 0 actions after a 57% spike warrants re-check before any paid reactivation.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions hit 0 for the last 3 consecutive days (2026-08-28 to 2026-08-30) after a 57% weekly spike driven by a single-day burst of 11 on 2026-08-25. No paid channel is live to backstop any further drop. Success check: if GBP actions return above 3/day average over the next 3 days, the spike is recovering; if they remain at 0 by 2026-09-03, escalate for review. Re-check 2026-09-03.

suggestions.text: Audit GA4 conversion event — 177 sessions, 0 conversions recorded; likely a broken form submission or missing event tag.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 shows 177 sessions and 147 users over the last 28 days but zero conversion events recorded, meaning no lead is being captured in analytics even if the form is functional. Test the contact or intake form end-to-end and confirm the GA4 conversion event fires on submission. Success check: at least 1 confirmed conversion event visible in GA4 real-time within 48 hours of the fix. Complete by 2026-09-03.
